scope: read-only audit; no new inference or human annotations

rows.finding: 10-query hosted listing has 10 context-budget/compaction errors at N1800; full-catalog local listing failure evidence already exists. It is false that no full6006 listing result exists anywhere. Wrapper failure does not establish the API model's native maximum.
rows.acceptance: New matched official-query panel; actual tokenized preflight; retain all sizes/failures; separate valid-inference and failure latency; do not alter historical run.

rows.finding: Unconstrained route failures are real, but a six-category constrained grammar already yielded 11/12 and 12/12 valid local rows. Absolute claim that no controlled comparison exists overlooks the two-query matched study. One-domain restriction and centroid routing are different arms.
rows.acceptance: Use a newly frozen independent router arm, preserve old zeros; report parse validity, empty domain, gold coverage and multi-domain ceiling.

rows.finding: Matched five-method two-query selection exists; CPU32 and full4392 metadata comparisons already control retrieval factors. Remaining gap is informative common-selector coverage and one canonical primary analysis, not implementing hybrid.
rows.acceptance: Extend one matched selector design rather than pooling studies. Same panel/candidate memberships, embedder, metadata, selector, metrics and cost ledger.

rows.finding: gpt-4.1-mini/nano execution not found in inspected catalog/config summaries; original factor not completed. Local names in first plan are wrong: Qwen3-0.6B Q8 and Qwen3.5-4B Q4, not Qwen3.5 0.6B/3.5B. --model already accepts arbitrary model strings.
rows.acceptance: Original model status table; retain exact unresolved hosted arms; verify availability/pin/credentials/rates before budget-authorized calls. Do not claim local substitutions reproduce them.

rows.finding: 3-query/2-query pilots cannot support reliable model rankings; n20 or n200 is not by itself a power guarantee.
rows.acceptance: Predeclare contrasts and sample/precision rationale; paired effect intervals; planned/attempted/valid counts; keep model/version/provider and repeated-query dependence explicit.

rows.finding: Full hosted expansion truly not admitted. US0.39 is historic pilot spend, not a verified repository-wide total. Jev full-text expansion cost cannot predict GPT/DeepSeek listing cost. POSIX fcntl is not native-Windows portable.
rows.acceptance: Immutable per-study ledgers; platform-appropriate atomic locking; estimate actual tokenized factorial including routing/output/canaries/retries and failure reserves. Paid model matrix remains pending authorization.

rows.finding: Full4392 BM25/vector/RRF work already exists; small scaling panel is separate. 'Retrieval is free' confuses zero hosted charge with zero compute cost.
rows.acceptance: Reuse verified artifacts for reanalysis; extend scaling only when it answers a predeclared question and fits wall-time/memory budget. Distinguish reanalysis from fresh inference.

rows.finding: Meaningful matched selection is incomplete. The plan's instruction to take blind queries from 4192 reserved IDs is obsolete after full4392 public studies. Also 50 generated BM25 selection cases exist; the 3/2/10 enumeration is incomplete.
rows.acceptance: Mark SkillRet exposed; freeze new panel before run; distinguish stratified selection from natural sampling; no fresh-heldout claim. Human independent panel separately pending.

rows.finding: Metadata scaling already uses seeds5150/5151/5152 across eight queries and random/hard-overlap conditions. Revised 43/44 are conditional on budget, not unconditional; exact named seeds not found in inspected runs.
rows.acceptance: Report existing seed evidence accurately. New primary design needs matched multi-seed sensitivity if claiming robustness; fullcatalog seed repeats are not independent catalogs.

rows.finding: CPU32 already uses exactly10/100/1000/6006; seed5150 uses six-size superset. The real gap is joint method/model/final-selection coverage.
rows.acceptance: Select one balanced size grid and disclose proposal deviations; do not add duplicate sizes merely for compliance.

rows.finding: Newer local selector logs already contain input/output/logical route tokens and physical reuse. Legacy listing/BM25 results do not. Universal token accounting remains incomplete.
rows.acceptance: Generate one measured token table; distinguish estimated preflight, actual model usage, embedding preprocessing/query tokens, logical routing and physical cached calls. Missing stays null.

rows.finding: Fresh all-cell end-to-end latency not present. CPU32 has matched fullcatalog warm timing. Dividing selector end-to-end latency at every N by retrieval-only BM25 at6006 is not a controlled end-to-end method contrast.
rows.acceptance: Same-size BM25+same-selector paired baseline; absolute and relative values; separate setup, failures, cache replay, successful serving and system resources.

rows.finding: Gold multiplicity is available; category co-membership does not prove overlap. Hard-overlap distractor sensitivity already exists. Dependency/cascade labels remain unsupported and revised proposal excludes chains.
rows.acceptance: Report gold-count/domain-coverage strata as proxies; label semantic overlap/cascade only after real adjudication; separate set coverage from sequence correctness.

rows.finding: Paper directory contains proposal/template/bibliography, not a canonical final report at baseline; source directories were inspected. This does not prove no private draft exists.
rows.acceptance: New final-report source, max6-page course body, traceable matched results, limitations and accurate contributions; preserve proposal. Compilation plus visual QA required.

rows.finding: No presentation artifact was found in inspected root/paper/docs navigation; no claim about uninspected private materials.
rows.acceptance: Create evidence-aligned 10-minute deck/outline and speaking assignments confirmed by humans; distinguish actual results and pending work.

rows.finding: No independently human-authored/adjudicated evaluation panel established by inspected evidence. Some hand-built fixture panels exist, so 'no manual cases anywhere' is too broad.
rows.acceptance: Prepare annotation guide/template; actual humans author and independently label/adjudicate; assistant-authored examples are synthetic, never human-labelled by assertion.

rows.finding: Extensions are substantial and partly answer retrieval tradeoffs. Claim that extensions came 'at expense of' proposal is an unsupported causal judgment. Original proposal explicitly permits refinement.
rows.acceptance: Separate original commitments, revised scope, supporting extensions and untested claims; preserve reported results/status; no fabricated reason for absent work.

rows.finding: The original5×4×4 matrix is an appropriate scope inventory. Revised proposal is narrower; not all80 cells must be run to report an honest reduced study.
rows.acceptance: Explicit cell statuses/evidence and reduced-scope claim; never fill gaps using incomparable results or model substitutions.

rows.finding: Five scenario categories are a useful proposed taxonomy but are not observed labels. Two-human agreement, adjudication, semantic overlap and dependency order cannot be inferred automatically from qrels.
rows.acceptance: Version proposed labels as draft/unadjudicated until real review; source-specific analysis; avoid obligatory semantic labels for official queries when only proxies are supported.

rows.finding: Stage metrics and traces exist across studies, but consistent primary-ledger integration remains. Older single-name scoring is incompatible with official multi-positive exact-set evaluation.
rows.acceptance: Build case ledger with explicit stage/validity denominators and null unavailable costs/times; score retrieval versus final selection separately; regenerate reports from saved rows.

rows.finding: Matched retrieval and tiny selector comparisons exist; the remaining deliverable is a clearly bounded primary analysis with uncertainty, not a universal leaderboard assembled across16 studies.
rows.acceptance: One primary matched analysis with predeclared contrasts, paired differences, relevant clustering and unchanged failure denominator. Other studies supporting only.

rows.finding: Three-seed/hard-overlap/representation/candidate-depth checks already exist, but independent fresh request generalization and repeated-training evidence remain limited.
rows.acceptance: Reuse existing diagnostics honestly; predeclare only conclusion-relevant new sensitivity; leave independent human panel and extensive training repeats pending or narrow claim.

rows.finding: Legacy listing normalizes names to paths without collision assertions, scores name equality, and may treat read_file/first text as selection. Actual lost-row/collision count was not measured. Recent alias-based selector avoids these risks.
rows.acceptance: New harness uses canonical unique IDs, collision-free alias/path map and strict schema. Test two different names that normalize identically; duplicate names; early text versus final tool call. Preserve historical artifacts.

rows.finding: Legacy listing builds one catalog preserving every query's gold-name union; raising query count can make N10/N50 impossible and skip them. It truncates description at300 characters, not proposed1024.
rows.acceptance: Use per-query shared nested libraries; full positive qrels and exact-set scorer; assert actual unique membership equals requested N; version exact rendered text hashes.

rows.finding: Positive qrels are incomplete evidence, not exhaustive semantic truth. Current set metrics assume nonempty positive sets; a natural random catalog may have no available gold without the user genuinely needing no skill.
rows.acceptance: Keep official-label evaluation intact; separately audit alternatives; never add gold to shortlists. Report catalog coverage, candidate ceiling, all-planned and available-gold conditional metrics with counts. Explicit new no-gold policy/tests if introduced.

rows.finding: A single-domain router cannot retrieve all required gold skills spanning multiple categories even with perfect routing. One 'correct category' accuracy is ambiguous for multicorrect queries.
rows.acceptance: For each query compute max_domain |G intersect domain|/|G|, any-positive and all-positive feasibility, plus observed route coverage; do not label two-domain/global fallback as same method.

rows.finding: Same queries recur across seeds/sizes/models; treating rows as independent inflates n. N20 or N200 not automatic power. Selecting primary method after viewing all public feedback is exposed exploratory analysis.
rows.acceptance: Pair/cluster by query or task family; confidence intervals for differences and rates; planned contrasts or multiplicity disclosure; no equivalence claim from non-significance.

rows.finding: Pilot records real SkillsMiddleware/StateBackend and bounded reads. Scaling uses direct local completion; it is not native middleware evidence. A read_file success does not mean skills ran or task succeeded.
rows.acceptance: Trace native middleware candidate injection, isolated select call and actual bounded read in separate live canary; offline fixtures only wiring. No arbitrary downloaded instructions executed.

rows.finding: Legacy listing only instructs not to use tools while default agent tools remain; newer pilot enforces isolation. Untrusted skill/query text may contain instructions or label-like cues.
rows.acceptance: Use explicit tool allowlist/read-only activation; prompt-boundary fixtures; labels/gold count never model inputs; audit actual serialized payload, candidate IDs and cache keys.

rows.finding: Historical source/vector provenance and response gaps are explicitly retained; replay is not fresh timing and estimates are not invoices. All-failure cells operational feasibility, not intrinsic model quality.
rows.acceptance: Model/tokenizer/artifact hashes; returned provider/version/date; actual calls vs reservations; regenerate aggregates offline; preserve unknowns and redaction distinction.
